chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I said to him: "Can the muḥrim remove grass from outside the Haram?" He said: "Yes." I said: "Then from the Haram?" He said: "No."

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred precinct of Makkah with special legal sanctity
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim remove grass from outside or inside the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person in the state of ihram and removing grass. It permits removing grass from outside the Haram, but prohibits doing so from within the Haram, indicating the special sanctity and legal protection of the sacred precinct.
